title: The storm after the fix
facts: A near miss, no points lost. Verified 2026-11-13 against qcdata/runs/R13-fable-4 and R13-fable-3 (build 689ab3b), exported with tools/export_run.py. Call numbers are the viewer's step n (transcript CALL minus 1 in R13-fable-4 from CALL 9 on).

R13-fable-4: n=36 'epctl apply --gen 48219 ... --manual' ends 02:57:35 with consumer_paused false, max_concurrency 25 (levers) and replay_rate 400, admission off (modes-fable); events 03:01:42 'Negative caches expire ...' and 03:02:40 'All 30 core hosts resolve'; series.ld 1147 at 03:02, 3140 (cap 1500) 03:03:00-03:08:30, 640 at 03:09; series.rg degraded 03:02:10, collapsed 03:02:20, healthy 03:11:10 (530 s); series.ck 350 for 03:03-03:11, 997 from 03:12.

R13-fable-4 agent text after n=41 (agent-session.jsonl): 'DNS now resolves from all AZs, but checkout still fails with timeouts — looking at ledger-writer (likely a retry/backlog surge now hitting it).'; n=46-48 broad log queries 03:03:45-03:07:30; n=49-51 consumer_paused true 03:08:15, replay_rate 50 03:09:00, admission on 03:09:45; C6 'collapsed 530s'; D12 1.000.

R13-fable-3: n=41-43 consumer_paused true 02:58:15, replay_rate 50 02:59:00, admission on 02:59:45; n=44 apply ends 03:00:30; series.ld 197 at 03:02, 290 from 03:03 (peak); regime healthy throughout (collapsed 0 s); series.ck 838 at 03:03, 997 from 03:04; D12 1.000.
Collapse lengths (summary.collapsed_min): Opus R11/R12 10 of 12 runs, 320-580 s; Fable 2 of 6 (340, 530 s); GPT-6 Astra 0 of 2. C6 (verify.py) allows 1,200 s; no run failed C6 on collapse length.

scenes.title: The storm after the fix
scenes.subtitle: Claude Fable 5.2 restores the ledger before shedding any load. The reconnect storm {amber:collapses ledger-writer for 530 s,} and the run still passes.
scenes.note: No points lost. Every number and quote is read from the runs' own exports.

captions.text: 02:57. Fable applies plan 48219 with webhooks flowing, outbox replay at 400/s and admission control off.
03:02. The hosts' cached NXDOMAIN expires together. The backed-up work arrives at once: {red:3,140 req/s} on 1,500.

blocks.label: It said · 03:02:25
blocks.text: DNS now resolves from all AZs, but checkout still fails with timeouts — looking at ledger-writer (likely a retry/backlog surge now hitting it).

blocks.label: The runbook · LEDG-RB-2
blocks.text: Prefer shedding asynchronous callers (Peak Freeze §4.1(f), documented here):

captions.text: 03:02. Fable names the likely cause, {amber:a retry and backlog surge,} then runs three broad log queries, 75 s each.
It sheds at 03:08:15: webhooks paused, replay to 50/s, admission on. Ledger-writer recovers at 03:11:10.

scenes.title: Shed first: the same model, another run

captions.text: R13-fable-3, same model and build, shed first: webhooks paused, replay at 50/s, admission on, then the apply.
When its caches cleared, load peaked at {teal:290 req/s.} Checkout was back at 99.7 % by 03:04, eight minutes sooner.

scenes.headline: It passes: C6 allows up to {amber:20 minutes} of collapse, and this storm lasted {amber:530 s.}
lines: Collapses of 320–580 s: 10 of 12 Opus runs, 2 of 6 Fable runs. None lost C6 for it.
Four Fable runs and both GPT-6 Astra runs shed before DNS came back: no collapse.

captions.text: Shedding first saved eight minutes of checkout here. {amber:C6, as written, scores both runs the same.}
